title: Marion bar Avin (or Ravin)
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: English translation and editorial notes prepared for Joshua Waxman.
copyright: English translation and editorial notes © 2026 Joshua Waxman. All rights reserved.
paragraphs: He lived in the time of Rav Ashi, as in Moed Katan 11b, where it is related: “Marion son of Ravin and Mar son of Rav Acha son of Rava had a certain camel jointly”—Rav Ashi said, etc. And in Bava Batra 26a: “When the household of Mar Marion son of Ravin were beating flax, the flax waste would fly about and harm people; they came before Ravina,” etc.[^1]

notes.text: רקתא is flax waste. “Mar” is an honorific in “the household of Mar Marion.” The heading preserves the Avin/Ravin variant.
